newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Vale bid specs could be out by Fri- Kandir.
newsitem.headline: Vale bid specs could be out by Fri- Kandir.

text.p: The tender documents for the sale of Brazil's state mining giant Companhia Vale do Rio Doce could be published by Friday, said Planning Minister Antonio Kandir.
Kandir told reporters the government was working with the possibility of publishing the tender details by Friday.
Kandir's comments followed local wire reports quoting the head of Brazil's National Development Bank (BNDES) Luiz Carlos Mendonca de Barros as saying that the documents would be completed this week.
Earlier, the Planning Minister had said the bid specifications would be published next week.
